SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-08-2008 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF TABARSI, SHAHIN ADBUL THOMAS, LESLEY ANN IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT LAKHAL, MAHER BEN MOHAMED REYES, EMELIA (1) THE COURT DETERMINES THAT THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN THE PARTIES DID NOT CREATE A TENANCY; (2) PLAINTIFF TABARSI MAY RECOVER HIS PERSONAL PROPERTY FROM DEFENDANT'S PREMISES AT HIS OWN EXPENSE, SUBJECT TO NOT LESS THAN 72 HOURS NOTICE; EITHER PARTY MY REQUEST A CIVIL STANDBY BY THE SAN FRANCISCO POLICE DEPARTMENT IN CONNECTION WITH PLAINTIFF'S RECOVERY OF HIS PROPERTY. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
